title.narrative: UNDP - Fas II Ixil Landsbygdsutveckling Gemensamt Program
UNDP - Phase II Ixil Rural Development Joint Program

description.narrative:
Det gemensamma programmet för landsbygdsutveckling i Ixil fas II syftar till att bidra till ökad motståndskraft mot socioekonomiska och miljömässiga chocker. Detta genom att minska befintliga multidimensionella deprivationer inom områdena livsmedelssäkerhet, hälsa, utbildning, bostäder, vatten och sanitet och inkomst samt genom att länka hållbar förvaltning av naturresurser , ekosystem, biologisk mångfald, förebyggande av katastrofrisker och anpassning av klimatförändringar i Nebaj, Cotzal och Chajul.
För att uppnå detta kommer programmet att stödja landsbygdsfamiljer, med ett särskilt fokus på kvinnor, ungdomar och barn under 5 år och "ancestriala" lokala myndigheter som rättighetsbärare samt institutioner inom specifika sektorer och kommuner som ansvarsbärare för att hantera multidimensionella deprivationer, hantera hållbar integrerad landsbygdsutveckling, med fokus på rättigheter, jämställdhet, miljö, katastrofriskhantering och klimatanpassning.

The Ixil Phase II Rural Development Joint Program aims to contribute to an increased resilience to socioeconomic and environmental shocks, by reducing their multidimensional deprivations related to food security, health, education, housing, water and sanitation and income, by linking sustainable management of natural resources, ecosystems, biodiversity, disaster risk prevention and climate change adaptation in Nebaj, Cotzal and Chajul.
To achieve this the program will support rural families, especially women, youth and children under 5 years and ancestral authorities as right holders; and sectoral institutions and municipalities as duty bearers to address multidimensional deprivations, manage sustainable integral rural development, with a focus on rights, gender sensitivity, environment, disaster risk management and climate change adaptation.

title.narrative: Program Document Joint Program Ixil Phase II 13391

description.narrative:
1170 families increased their knowledge in SMART agriculture and established 1170 vegetables orchards, in 2022 the families didn´t have orchards but during 2023 the families achieved to plant, grow and harvest vegetables for self-consumption and for sale. This are important achievements since these actions allowed access to food.
During 2023, 26 small egg production facilities started producing around 64,000 eggs, this has supported the families to diversify their food, introduce animal protein to their diet and produce income through the eggs sale. Around 50% of the eggs produced were sold within the communities.
50 families living in high-risk conditions were trained to improve their family surroundings, by identifying risks in their land and how to improve the risk.
The Communitarian Development Councils with the program support trained and restructured the Local Disaster Risk Coordinators (COLRED) to be able to support the communities in disaster response.
The Ministry of Health with the program´s support provided training to 79 midwives and 15 nurses to promote breast feeding to improve the nutritional health of children.
Planning Secretariat - SEGEPLAN with the program´s support has implemented actions to improve the public investment plans by training the Departmental Technical Unit (UTD) and the Municipal Planning Directors.
With the program´s support the Ministry of Agriculture has restructured the Departmental Agriculture Coordination Council - COAPED including the Municipalities of Nebaj, Cotzal and Chajul.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
